doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: After Sun Ra's death
summary: Allen decided to carry on as Sun Ra instructed and keep the band and music together amid dispersed estate matters.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: This may be a very obvious question but what was the mood of the band when Sun Ra passed?

Well everybody was wondering what am I supposed to do now? Supposed to go home just like he said to do. He said don’t worry, carry on. So that’s what I did. I was worrying about now what am I going to do with all this stuff, all this music, what — do I walk away from it or do I stand my ground and work hard and keep it up? So I had to make that decision. So I made a decision, nobody else left, what am I going to do all these years wasted? No. Carry on as best you can.
Did you have to deal with let’s say other interested parties in Sun Ra’s estate and legacy?

Well that — part of it went one way, this part went, this here went this way. So all you could do is put it together. And that’s the way it is. Sun Ra wanted me to keep the band so I’ll keep the band and keep the music longer, and found whatever they get that goes that way. You see what I mean?
